script: You only know the tip of the iceberg when it comes to true tragedy. We often focus just on the immediate event, the shocking incident itself. But what about the devastating ripple effects that follow? The slow, agonizing decline for those affected? Or the systemic failures that made it all seem inevitable? Experts describe 7 distinct levels of tragedy, each one peeling back deeper layers of suffering. It's not just the disaster you see on the news. It's the silent battles, the forgotten victims, and the long-term impact that reshapes entire communities, often for generations. This hidden side of human suffering proves that you only know the tip of the iceberg when it comes to true tragedy.
